conceptBreakdown.content:
### 4.1 Industrial Organic Acids Matrix

| Organic Acid | Producing Microorganism | Taxon Class | Industrial Applications |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Citric Acid** | ***Aspergillus niger*** | Fungus (Ascomycete) | Food and beverage acidulant, antioxidant, pharmaceutical preservative, effervescent powders |
| **Acetic Acid** | ***Acetobacter aceti*** | Bacterium (Aerobic) | Vinegar production, chemical synthesis of acetate esters |
| **Butyric Acid** | ***Clostridium butylicum*** | Bacterium (Obligate Anaerobe) | Flavoring agent, industrial chemical intermediate, solvent manufacturing |
| **Lactic Acid** | ***Lactobacillus* species** | Bacterium | Food acidification, dairy starter, synthesis of biodegradable polylactic acid (PLA) bioplastics |

### 4.2 Industrial Enzymes & Commercial Applications
1. **Lipases** (*Candida lipolytica*, *Aspergillus*):
   - Enzyme that hydrolyzes ester bonds in triacylglycerols to release free fatty acids and glycerol.
   - **Application**: Formulated into **laundry detergents** to effectively digest lipid and grease stains from fabrics.
2. **Pectinases & Proteases** (*Aspergillus niger*, *Sclerotinia libertiana*):
   - Pectins and structural proteins cause cloudiness in freshly pressed fruit juices.
   - **Application**: Pectinases and proteases are added to commercial bottled fruit juices to degrade suspended colloidal particles, producing **crystal-clear clarified bottled juices**.
3. **Streptokinase** (*Streptococcus* species):
   - Genetic engineering modifies streptokinase for clinical use as a thrombolytic clot buster in acute coronary syndrome.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Enzyme Immobilization Techniques
conceptBreakdown.title: Enzyme Immobilization Techniques
conceptBreakdown.content: Industrial enzymes are chemically or physically immobilized on inert insoluble matrices (e.g., sodium alginate beads, polyacrylamide, porous silica) to permit continuous bioreactor processing and enzyme recovery without contaminating product streams.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Microbial Gluconic Acid
conceptBreakdown.title: Microbial Gluconic Acid
conceptBreakdown.content: Gluconic acid produced by Aspergillus niger and Gluconobacter oxydans from glucose is widely used in pharmaceuticals (calcium gluconate injections for hypocalcemia) and in textile cleaning.
